### Scaffold project with tiged

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/index.md

Create a local copy of a community template hosted on GitHub. Installs dependencies and starts the development server.

```bash
npx tiged user/project my-project
cd my-project

npm install
npm run dev
```

### Start Dev Server with CPU Profiling using `vite --profile --open`

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md

Starts the Vite development server with the built-in Node.js inspector and opens the app in the browser. Once loaded, press `p` in the terminal to stop the inspector and `q` to stop the dev server.

```bash
vite --profile --open
```

--------------------------------

### Create and start a Vite dev server with createServer

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-javascript.md

Initializes, starts, and prints URLs for a Vite development server programmatically with custom port and root configurations.

```ts
import { createServer } from 'vite'

const server = await createServer({
  // any valid user config options, plus `mode` and `configFile`
  configFile: false,
  root: import.meta.dirname,
  server: {
    port: 1337,
  },
})
await server.listen()

server.printUrls()
server.bindCLIShortcuts({ print: true })
```

### Install Babel decorator plugins

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/migration.md


```bash

```

```bash
$ pnpm add -D @rolldown/plugin-babel @babel/plugin-proposal-decorators
```

```bash
$ bun add -D @rolldown/plugin-babel @babel/plugin-proposal-decorators
```

```bash
$ deno add -D npm:@rolldown/plugin-babel npm:@babel/plugin-proposal-decorators
```

### Installing CSS pre-processors

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/features.md

Installs the required pre-processor packages for Sass, Less, or Stylus support in Vite without extra plugins.

```bash
# .scss and .sass
npm add -D sass-embedded # or sass

# .less
npm add -D less

# .styl and .stylus
npm add -D stylus
```

### Preview production build with vite preview

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/cli.md

Locally previews the production build by starting a server in the build directory. Run vite build beforehand to ensure the output directory is up-to-date.

```bash
vite preview [root]
```

--------------------------------

### Inject post-middleware using configurePreviewServer

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-plugin.md

Configure the preview server by returning a function from configurePreviewServer to inject middleware after internal middlewares are installed.

```js
const myPlugin = () => ({
  name: 'configure-preview-server',
  configurePreviewServer(server) {
    // return a post hook that is called after other middlewares are
    // installed
    return () => {
      server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
        // custom handle request...
      })
    }
  },
})
```

### Multi-page application source code structure

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/build.md

Example folder structure for a multi-page Vite application with nested HTML entry points.

```text
├── package.json
├── vite.config.js
├── index.html
├── main.js
└── nested
    ├── index.html
    └── nested.js
```

### Example .vite/manifest.json structure

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/backend-integration.md

Output generated in outDir after running vite build when manifest is enabled, mapping source entries to output assets and dependencies.

```json
{
  "_shared-B7PI925R.js": {
    "file": "assets/shared-B7PI925R.js",
    "name": "shared",
    "css": ["assets/shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css"]
  },
  "_shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css": {
    "file": "assets/shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css",
    "src": "_shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css"
  },
  "logo.svg": {
    "file": "assets/logo-BuPIv-2h.svg",
    "src": "logo.svg"
  },
  "baz.js": {
    "file": "assets/baz-B2H3sXNv.js",
    "name": "baz",
    "src": "baz.js",
    "isDynamicEntry": true
  },
  "views/bar.js": {
    "file": "assets/bar-gkvgaI9m.js",
    "name": "bar",
    "src": "views/bar.js",
    "isEntry": true,
    "imports": ["_shared-B7PI925R.js"],
    "dynamicImports": ["baz.js"]
  },
  "views/foo.js": {
    "file": "assets/foo-BRBmoGS9.js",
    "name": "foo",
    "src": "views/foo.js",
    "isEntry": true,
    "imports": ["_shared-B7PI925R.js"],
    "css": ["assets/foo-5UjPuW-k.css"]
  }
}
```

### Start Vite with native config loader

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/config/index.md

Executes the original config file directly so breakpoints in the config file and plugin hooks map to the original source. Requires a runtime supporting the syntax used, such as Node.js 22.18+ for TypeScript files.

```bash
vite --configLoader native
```

--------------------------------

### Perform dynamic import with variables

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/features.md

Demonstrates dynamic imports with variable file paths. Note that variables only match file names one level deep, and imports must start with ./, ../, or # and include a file extension.

```ts
const module = await import(`./dir/${file}.js`)
```

### Import and initialize WebAssembly modules using ?init

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/blog/announcing-vite3.md

Import a WebAssembly file using the ?init query suffix and invoke the default export to instantiate the module.

```javascript
import init from './example.wasm?init'

init().then((instance) => {
  instance.exports.test()
})
```

### Configure build and preview scripts in package.json

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/static-deploy.md

Sets up standard npm scripts to build the project and preview the build output locally. Note that `vite preview` is intended for local inspection and not as a production server.

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "build": "vite build",
    "preview": "vite preview"
  }
}
```


--------------------------------

### Configure multiple entries library build in vite.config.js

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/build.md

Sets up build.lib with multiple entry files and externalizes dependencies.

```javascript
import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  build: {
    lib: {
      entry: {
        'my-lib': resolve(import.meta.dirname, 'lib/main.js'),
        secondary: resolve(import.meta.dirname, 'lib/secondary.js'),
      },
      name: 'MyLib',
    },
    rolldownOptions: {
      // make sure to externalize deps that shouldn't be bundled
      // into your library
      external: ['vue'],
      output: {
        // Provide global variables to use in the UMD build
        // for externalized deps
        globals: {
          vue: 'Vue',
        },
      },
    },
  },
})
```

### Configure Cloudflare Workers in Vite

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/static-deploy.md

Install @cloudflare/vite-plugin and configure vite.config.js and wrangler.jsonc to integrate Cloudflare Workers with Vite.

```bash
$ npm install --save-dev @cloudflare/vite-plugin
```

```js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import { cloudflare } from '@cloudflare/vite-plugin'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [cloudflare()],
})
```

```jsonc
{
  "name": "my-vite-app",
}
```

--------------------------------

### Configure single entry library build in vite.config.js

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/build.md

Sets up build.lib with a single entry point and externalizes dependencies like Vue for library bundling.

```javascript
import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  build: {
    lib: {
      entry: resolve(import.meta.dirname, 'lib/main.js'),
      name: 'MyLib',
      // the proper extensions will be added
      fileName: 'my-lib',
    },
    rolldownOptions: {
      // make sure to externalize deps that shouldn't be bundled
      // into your library
      external: ['vue'],
      output: {
        // Provide global variables to use in the UMD build
        // for externalized deps
        globals: {
          vue: 'Vue',
        },
      },
    },
  },
})
```

--------------------------------

### Configure devtools with apply option in defineConfig

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/config/shared-options.md

Configure the experimental devtools integration in the user config to run only during serve. Requires @vitejs/devtools to be installed as a dependency.

```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  devtools: {
    apply: 'serve',
  },
})
```

### Run a staging build with custom mode and .env.staging file

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/env-and-mode.md

Overrides the default production mode during build using the --mode flag and loads matching variables from .env.staging.

```bash
vite build --mode staging
```

```[.env.staging]
VITE_APP_TITLE=My App (staging)
```

### Import static assets with custom query suffixes

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/playground/assets/index.html

Demonstrates various asset imports using query parameters such as ?url, ?raw, ?inline, and ?no-inline to control loading and bundler behavior.

```javascript
@import '/foo.css'; import './css/fonts.css' import './css/css-url.css' import './css/icons.css' import './css/manual-chunks.css' import { multilineUrl } from './multiline-import-meta-url.js' text('.base', `import.meta.${``}env.BASE_URL: ${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}`) import url from './nested/asset.png' text('.asset-import-relative', url) import absoluteUrl from '/nested/asset.png' text('.asset-import-absolute', absoluteUrl) import publicUrl from '/icon.png' text('.public-import', publicUrl) import typeofAssetUrl from './nested/asset2.png' if (typeof typeofAssetUrl === 'string') { text('.asset-import-typeof', 'string') } import publicJsonUrl from '/foo.json?url' text('.public-json-import', publicJsonUrl) ;(async () => { const res = await fetch(publicJsonUrl) text('.public-json-import-content', await res.text()) })() import publicJsUrl from '/raw.js?url' text('.public-js-import', publicJsUrl) ;(async () => { const res = await fetch(publicJsUrl) text('.public-js-import-content', await res.text()) text( '.public-js-import-content-type', await res.headers.get('Content-Type'), ) })() import publicTsUrl from '/raw.ts?url' text('.public-ts-import', publicTsUrl) ;(async () => { const res = await fetch(publicTsUrl) text('.public-ts-import-content', await res.text()) text( '.public-ts-import-content-type', await res.headers.get('Content-Type'), ) })() import publicMtsUrl from '/raw.mts?url' text('.public-mts-import', publicMtsUrl) ;(async () => { const res = await fetch(publicMtsUrl) text('.public-mts-import-content', await res.text()) text( '.public-mts-import-content-type', await res.headers.get('Content-Type'), ) })() import svgFrag from './nested/fragment.svg' text('.svg-frag-import-path', svgFrag) document.querySelector('.svg-frag-import').src = svgFrag + '#icon-heart-view' import unknownExtUrl from './nested/foo.unknown' text('.unknown-ext', unknownExtUrl) import unknownExtInlineUrl from './nested/foo.unknown?inline' text('.unknown-ext-inline', unknownExtInlineUrl) import relativePathCustomUrl from './nested/relative-path.custom' text('.relative-path-assets-include', relativePathCustomUrl) import relativePathCustomInlineUrl from './nested/relative-path.custom?inline' text('.relative-path-assets-include-inline', relativePathCustomInlineUrl) import rawSvg from './nested/fragment.svg?raw' text('.raw', rawSvg) import rawHtml from './nested/partial.html?raw' text('.raw-html', rawHtml) import.meta.hot?.accept('./nested/partial.html?raw', (m) => { text('.raw-html', m.default) }) import noInlineSvg from './nested/fragment.svg?no-inline' text('.no-inline-svg', noInlineSvg) import noInlineSvgMP from './nested/fragment.svg?no-inline&foo=bar' text('.no-inline-svg-mp', noInlineSvgMP) import inlinePng from './nested/asset.png?inline' text('.inline-png', inlinePng) import inlinePublicPng from '/icon.png?inline' text('.inline-public-png', inlinePublicPng) import inlinePublicJson from '/foo.json?url&inline' text('.inline-public-json', inlinePublicJson) import fooUrl from './foo.js?url' text('.url', fooUrl) import unicodeUrl from './テスト-測試-white space.js?url' text('.unicode-url', unicodeUrl) import filenameIncludingSingleQuoteUrl from "./nested/with-single'quote.png" text('.filename-including-single-quote', filenameIncludingSingleQuoteUrl) // TODO: is not supported yet (https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/16243) // import percentUrl from './asset/percent%25.png?url' // text('.percent-url', percentUrl) import cssUrl from './css/icons.css?url' text('.url-css', cssUrl) import cssUrlUrl from './css/css-url-url.css?url' const linkTag = document.createElement('link') linkTag.href = cssUrlUrl linkTag.rel = 'stylesheet' document.body.appendChild(linkTag) //
```

--------------------------------

### Configure type-aware lint rules in .oxlintrc.json

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts/README.md

Enables type-aware linting with the react, typescript, and oxc plugins in .oxlintrc.json for production applications after installing oxlint-tsgolint.

```json
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/oxlint/configuration_schema.json",
  "plugins": ["react", "typescript", "oxc"],
  "options": {
    "typeAware": true
  },
  "rules": {
    "react/rules-of-hooks": "error",
    "react/only-export-components": ["warn", { "allowConstantExport": true }]
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Access WebAssembly Module via URL import

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/features.md

Uses the ?url query suffix to get the resolved asset URL for explicit instantiation using WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming.

```js
import 'vite/client'
// ---cut---
import wasmUrl from 'foo.wasm?url'

const main = async () => {
  const responsePromise = fetch(wasmUrl)
  const { module, instance } =
    await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(responsePromise)
  /* ... */
}

main()
```
